definition: None of the three sources describe ThinkPrune's own recipe; it appears as a named comparison point. EvoThink cuts overthinking via Self-Pruning Training (deleting reasoning steps whose local conclusion repeats the previous one) plus Aha-Moment Preference Optimization (DPO on wrong-to-right preference pairs); QLPO resamples an over-generated rollout group to favour short-correct and long-incorrect trajectories; DiffAdapt trains a small probe to classify each question's difficulty and picks a matching prompt, temperature and token limit without retraining the base model.

evidence.note: EvoThink cuts overthinking in two separable stages: Self-Pruning Training deletes reasoning steps whose local conclusion repeats the previous step's and self-trains on the shortened traces, while Aha-Moment Preference Optimization builds from-wrong-to-right preference pairs out of the model's most diverse failed attempts and applies DPO to them.
evidence.title: EvoThink: Evolving Thinking in Large Reasoning Models via Self-Pruning and Aha-Moment Preference Optimization

evidence.note: QLPO is a GRPO variant that leaves the reward, advantage estimator and update untouched and instead over-generates K=16 rollouts per prompt and resamples the M=8 training group to favour short-correct and long-incorrect trajectories, which shortens outputs by 30-70% relative to GRPO at roughly unchanged accuracy.
evidence.title: QLPO: Quadrant-weighted Sampling for Length-aware Policy Optimization

evidence.note: DiffAdapt trains a small probe on a reasoning model's hidden state to classify each question as Easy/Normal/Hard and picks a matching prompt, temperature and token limit, cutting token use without retraining the model.
evidence.title: DiffAdapt: Difficulty-Adaptive Reasoning for Token-Efficient LLM Inference

name: ThinkPrune
